data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows an opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) of GBP 1.113m. Using the gross claims development table the syndicate experienced overall favourable prior-year reserve development of approximately GBP 1.011m (a release), driven by reductions in the estimated incurred claims on older underwriting years (notably 2013 and 2014) partly offset by an adverse movement on 2012. No explicit narrative quantifying a gross prior-year movement was provided; the movement has been calculated from the gross claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: increased loss ratio for the 2015 YOA, driven by the number of lives lost with the sums assured being above the average.
reduction in premium income due to the non-renewal of certain legacy business.
claims 'incurred but not reported' reserve based on a reporting delay of eight to twelve weeks.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure was not stated explicitly as a GROSS movement in narrative or a dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision' note. The prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Note 14). Triangle and balance sheet figures are in GBP 000; converted to millions for this output. Confidence is moderate (0.8) for the PYD as it is derived from the triangle rather than an explicit gross movement line. No explicit verbatim sentence quantifying the gross prior-year movement was found.
